parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', placing it squarely inside an Examples/SampleApp directory tree. Even though the is_sample_app flag is false, the file path is the authoritative restraint signal: the WallpaperSampleApp copy of MetricRow is a deliberate local replica that allows the sample app to render its debug HUD without taking a hard dependency on the DebugPanel package. Lifting the shared definition into DebugPanel and forcing WallpaperSampleApp to import it would couple a demonstration target to a production framework, which is the canonical anti-pattern the sample-app-mirror rule guards against. The structural match (exact duplicate, shared_field_count: 3) is real but incidental to this boundary.
